dataset_title: Protein recovery and lactic-acid fermentation outcomes from saline halophyte green juice
source_title: Report on optimisation of simple protein precipitation by acidification
doi_or_stable_id: H2020 grant agreement 862834, Deliverable D5.6 v1.0
source_location: Methods §§3.1–3.7, pp. 7–10; Table 3, p. 13; §4.4 and Table 4, pp. 14–15
license: Public dissemination level (PU) H2020 project deliverable; no explicit Creative Commons license identified. Attribution is retained; verify rights before redistribution beyond factual citation.
applicability: Laboratory protein-enriched-concentrate recovery from Salicornia ramosissima and Tripolium pannonicum saline green juice; one table reports lactic-acid fermentation to endpoint pH in a 1 L system.
measurement_basis: Table 3 reports PEC yield, dry matter in PEC, and total-N-derived crude protein content; PEC-yield denominator is not defined. Table 4 gives study dry-matter and crude-protein recovery equations as amount in PEC divided by amount in incoming juice. Crude protein uses total nitrogen multiplied by 6.00.
conversion_and_scaling: Table values and reported SDs are transcribed without conversion.
Source-reported fermentation times 9 h 30 min and 5 h 30 min are converted to 570 and 330 min; SDs 40 and 15 min are retained.
HCl amount is retained as the strict source bound (<1 mL of 7.7 M HCl per 200 mL juice); it is not converted into an exact reagent dose or a GreenHub acid-demand estimate.
uncertainty: Table 3 gives mean and SD; the report says precipitation experiments were generally duplicates and analytical work triplicates unless stated otherwise. Table 4 provides mean and SD and statistical comparisons, but its fermenter replicate count is not stated. No transfer uncertainty is quantified.
runtime_mapping: None. This asset is not mapped to GreenHub input defaults, acid-demand parameters, recovery equations, or process routes.
limitations: The feedstocks are saline halophytes, not roadside grass or VARTA grass.
Salicornia and Tripolium were cultivated in distinct contexts; Salicornia greenhouse soil used seawater irrigation and Tripolium was hydroponic with 7 g/L NaCl.
The Table 3 PEC-yield denominator is not specified; retain it as reported and do not use it as a mass-flow factor.
Crude protein is estimated from total N using Jones factor 6.00 and may include non-protein nitrogen.
HCl amount is only <1 mL per 200 mL juice to pH 3.5; no exact acid consumption, titration curve, or GreenHub transfer value is reported.
No complete component mass balance, commercial-scale data, or GreenHub validation is provided.
Public-project dissemination status does not establish a blanket data-reuse license.
metadata_gaps: Table 4 fermenter replicate count not reported
